kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-ack-cluster-connector --region-no cn-hangzhou --connector-name ack-cluster-connector-name --cluster-id cb0f5640b1b2d404cad6ba21509d7847b --primary-vswitch-id vsw-2zerfbbje7dvnbii20000 --ttl 30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAckClusterConnector

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: ACK集群资源所属的阿里云UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
[DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node regions.

For more information about the regions supported by ACK cluster connectors in Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2865120.html
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器地域ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~)：查询同步节点地域列表。

关于云防火墙支持ACK集群连接器地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2865120.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The name of the ACK cluster connector. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: ACK集群连接器名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: connector_name

parameters.help_en:
The ACK cluster ID. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
[DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~): Queries the list of ACK clusters
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群ID。取值来源：
[DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~)：批量查询ACK集群列表
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node vSwitches
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器主交换机。取值来源：
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机列表

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector
parameters.name: primary_vswitch_ip

parameters.help_en:
The standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
[DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node vSwitches
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器备交换机。取值来源：

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_ip

parameters.help_zh: ACK集群连接器同步周期间隔。范围：2~60秒
parameters.name: ttl
